Non-use of cancer equipments
*81. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether according to the Delhi
Cancer Registry (DCR) maintained by the
Indian Council of Medical Research
(ICMR), the rate of breast cancer has
increased manifold;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are aware that
the expensive equipments imported by
various hospitals in Delhi for treatment of
cancer patients are lying idle and not in use
for the last few years; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor with the
names of the hospitals that are not using the
equipments imported from abroad?
Rain harvesting projects
*82. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
SHRI   SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to develop more rain harvesting
projects in Delhi and other metros;
(b) if so, the details of such
proposals;
(c) the funds proposed to be allocated
towards the same; and
(d) whether Government realise the
seriousness of harvesting rain water and
how Government propose to educate the
various municipal corporations in this
regard?

DDA's Rohini Scheme 1980-81
*83. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that DDA's Rohini
Scheme 1980-81 envisaged allotment of
HIG and MIG plots to all applicants in five
years;
(b) if so, what is the total number of
plots for which applications have been
received for these categories, the allotments
of plots made upto the year 1990 and every
year thereafter and the rate at which these
plots were sold;
(c) the reasons for inordinate delay in
allotment of plots; and
(d) the steps being taken to clear the
waiting list on priority or by offering
alternative sites?
Waiting  list  for  Government
accommodation in Delhi
*84. SHRI JANARDHANA POOJARY:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the various types of Government
residential accommodation available in the
Capital for allotment to various categories
of Central Government functionaries;
(b) whether it is a fact that inspite of
putting in more than 20 years of service,
there are innumerable Central Government
functionaries at various levels still waiting
for allotment;
(c) if so, the number and categories of
Central Government functionaries who are
awaiting their turn for over 10 years in each
type of accommodation; and
(d) the details of the steps taken to
mitigate housing problem and hasten
allotment of accommodation?
Kidney case
*85. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned, "Cop
says doctors removed kidney and didn't tell",
which appeared in the Hindustan Times,
dated the 23rd September, 2002;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether any inquiry has been/is
being instituted to investigate into the
incident;
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(e) whether any action is being
contemplated against the concerned doctor(s)
for such professional misconduct?
Welfare fund for journalists
*86. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a Journalists’ Welfare Fund
for providing ex-gratia relief to the
journalists exists;
(b) if so, the total amount in this fund, as
on date; and
(c) the number of journalists/families of
journalists benefited, so far?

Quality of drinking water in Delhi
*87. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has come to the notice of
Government that an independent survey
conducted by a prominent national daily,
recently throws up several disturbing facts
about the quality of drinking water supplied
to various parts of the Capital;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the sample of
Delhi Jal Board has failed in the test
conducted by the All India Institute of
Medical Sciences also leading to an
outbreak of typhoid amongst its doctors;
and
(d) if so, the preventive and remedial
steps proposed in this regard?

Nodal agency for export of garlic,
onion and potato
†455. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that nodal agencies
have been created in several States for the
export of garlic, onion, potato, etc.;
(b) if so, the names of said States who
have formed such agencies; and
(c) whether any target has been fixed for
the export of these commodities and whether
any scheme has been formulated by
Government for their export keeping in view
the prices thereof in the domestic markets?
Decline in capital investment
†456. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has been
a decline in capital investment in certain
industries in the country during the years
1996-97 to 2000-2001;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the industries in which
capital investment has declined in the said
period; and
(d) the details of the industries in which
capital investment has increased in the said
period?
New Patent Regime
457. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Patent regime unlikely to benefit
developing nations: UK Report", which
appeared in the Economic Times, dated the
20th September, 2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto; and
(c) the details of steps Government
propose to take with regard to the major

problems highlighted in the report so as to
adequately safeguard the interests of the
developing countries especially India in the
new patent regime?
Export of sandal wood
458. SHRI C. O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the volume of sandal wood exported
during the last five years;
(b) the details of foreign exchange earned
during the above said period;
(c) whether it is a fact that India lost its
position as a leading exporter of sandal
wood;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the details of steps Government have
taken in this regard?
Industrial projects in Himachal
Pradesh
459. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of industrial projects from
Himachal Pradesh pending for approval by
Government during the year 2001-2002
along with the reasons therefor;
(b) the details of cost of each of such
project; and
(c) by when these projects will be cleared
by Government?
Financial assistance to States
460. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have allocated
a sum of Rs. 330 crore for assistance to
States for development of infrastructure for
exports and other allied activities;
(b) the quantum of money which has
been actually released out of Rs. 330 crore
allocated for the current year under this
programme;
(c) the names of the States that received
the assistance State-wise; and
(d) the details of projects which have
been initiated?
Revival of cement industry
461. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cement plants/factories
functioning in the country, State-wise,
particularly in Gujarat;
(b) the present average production
capacity of these plants/factories;
(c) the number of plants/factories, out of
these, which have been closed and those on
the verge of closure along with the reasons
for closure of those plants/factories; and
(d) the steps taken by Government for
revival of such plants/factories?
India Brand Equity Fund
462. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) when the India Brand Equity Fund
to promote Indian Brands in the international
market was established;
(b) the number of proposals which have
come before it for assistance, so far,
year-wise;

(c) the number of proposals accepted by
Government, year-wise; and
(d) the total corpus available in the fund?
